payload.description_html: (A), silhouette of Maip macrothorax showing the preserved bones in white. (B), reconstruction of the thoracic cavity of Maip at level of D6. (C), interpretative drawing of the excavation of Maip showing the original disposition of the bones. Abbreviations: a, axis; c, coracoid; ind, indeterminate bone; g, gastralia; r, rib; v, vertebrae.
